title: Dropping on an inactive technician or a failed drop recovers cleanly
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in on the Work Orders build under test with Work Orders view permission and Work Orders create-and-edit; the Board View and Tech View display options are on.
  2. The current location has at least 3 lead technicians shown as groups/columns (a technician is eligible when they are Clockable, Active, and their role is not Office or Time Clock User).
  3. Via New Work Order, create several work orders and set a Lead Technician on each, spread across the technicians with some left Unassigned; then open the Work Orders page.
  4. An inactive technician present; ability to force a reassignment failure.
custom_steps:
1. Try to drag a work order onto an inactive technician and confirm it is refused.
  2. With reassignment forced to fail, drag a work order to a valid technician and confirm the card returns to origin with the failure alert.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • The inactive-destination restriction and the failure recovery from Story 4 apply to drag reassignment.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10043 (Work Orders — Board View & Tech View Display Options). Story reference: SV-10052 — Story 9 Drag to reorder. Spec: Confluence page 845185030 “Work Orders — Board View & Tech View Display Options (Draft Spec)”, Draft v0.9, requirement(s) S9-N2 (read 23 Sep 2026). Review decisions/answers: Confluence page 853901313 where cited. Source-verified on 23 September 2026; not yet build-verified.
